notes: The application tracker on each university course can now be edited. Add your own steps, remove ones that don't apply, and set what a new course starts with in Settings. A UK application doesn't need a portfolio deadline and a US one doesn't need an interview to prepare for, so the built-in seven were never going to suit everyone.

Finishing something started in the last update: when your trial ends, the boxes you can no longer type in are greyed out too, not just the buttons. Renaming a subject and only discovering on the way out that it wouldn't save was the last version of a problem that should be gone.
